data.body: AC amendment (gap finding 5): .test-index anchor must be uniqueness-safe. The existing SKILL.md line in .test-index ends with test entries from test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh. Use the last existing test entry as the unique anchor in the Edit old_string (e.g., the last 'test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh [test_ui_classifier_failure_fallthrough]' entry), and append the 4 new entries immediately after.
